summary: General small-étale-site infrastructure (wrappers, `etaleComp`, `etaleOverEquiv`, `restrictSheaf` and its compatibility isos, `iUnion_range_iso_comp_eq_univ`, `subsingleton_of_isEmpty`) is published under `TauCeti.FiniteEtaleScheme` in a finite-étale file, includes duplicates of Mathlib and pointless `Iso.refl` wrappers, and hides the general covering/gluing lemmas plus all `etaleOverEquiv` lemmas as `private`. `restrictSheaf`/`etaleComp` expose their bodies as `abbrev` instead of providing value lemmas, and the basic `etaleMap_*` normal-form lemmas lack `@[simp]`.
